vast.en: The desert covers a vast area beyond the mountain range.
vast.zh: 沙漠覆蓋了山脈另一側的廣大區域。

vegetable.en: Each vegetable in the garden was labeled for the science project.
vegetable.zh: 花園裡的每種蔬菜都為科學專題標上名稱。

vegetarian.en: The cafeteria provides a vegetarian option at lunch each day.
vegetarian.zh: 學校餐廳每天午餐都提供素食選項。

veil.en: A thin veil of mist covered the lake at sunrise.
veil.zh: 日出時，一層薄霧籠罩湖面。

velvet.en: The museum displayed a velvet jacket from the nineteenth century.
velvet.zh: 博物館展示了一件十九世紀的天鵝絨外套。

vendor.en: A food vendor opened a small stall near the festival entrance.
vendor.zh: 一名食品攤販在節慶入口附近開了小攤位。

venture.en: The students began a new venture selling handmade cards for charity.
venture.zh: 學生開始一項販售手工卡片做公益的新計畫。

venue.en: The school gym was chosen as the venue for the ceremony.
venue.zh: 學校體育館被選為典禮場地。

verbal.en: The teacher gave verbal instructions before handing out the worksheet.
verbal.zh: 老師在發下學習單前先口頭說明。

verdict.en: The debate judges announced their verdict after reviewing every argument.
verdict.zh: 辯論評審檢視所有論點後公布評決。

verse.en: The class read one verse from the poem and discussed its imagery.
verse.zh: 班上讀了一節詩，並討論其中的意象。

versus.en: The chart compares studying alone versus studying in a group.
versus.zh: 圖表比較獨自讀書與小組讀書。

vertical.en: Draw a vertical line through the center of the graph.
vertical.zh: 在圖表中央畫一條垂直線。

vessel.en: The research vessel returned to port after collecting ocean samples.
vessel.zh: 研究船採集海洋樣本後返回港口。

vest.en: The volunteer wore a bright vest so visitors could find help easily.
vest.zh: 志工穿著醒目的背心，讓訪客容易找到協助。

vet.en: The vet examined the rescued dog at the animal center.
vet.zh: 獸醫在動物中心檢查那隻獲救的狗。

veteran.en: The interview features a veteran teacher reflecting on thirty years of education.
veteran.zh: 訪談邀請一位資深教師回顧三十年的教育經驗。

veterinarian.en: A veterinarian explained basic animal care during the school visit.
veterinarian.zh: 一位獸醫在到校活動中說明基本動物照護。

veto.en: The textbook explains how a veto can affect the lawmaking process.
veto.zh: 課本說明否決權如何影響立法程序。

via.en: The files were shared via the school's online learning system.
via.zh: 這些檔案透過學校的線上學習系統分享。

vibrate.en: The phone began to vibrate quietly during the meeting.
vibrate.zh: 會議期間，手機開始安靜地震動。

vibration.en: The sensor detected a small vibration from the moving machine.
vibration.zh: 感應器偵測到運轉中機器產生的輕微震動。

victor.en: The final match decided which team would emerge as the victor.
victor.zh: 決賽決定哪支隊伍會成為勝者。

viewer.en: Each viewer can choose subtitles from the video settings menu.
viewer.zh: 每位觀看者都能從影片設定選單選擇字幕。

viewpoint.en: The essay presents more than one viewpoint on the issue.
viewpoint.zh: 這篇文章呈現對該議題不只一種觀點。

vigor.en: The team returned to the project with renewed vigor after the break.
vigor.zh: 休息後，團隊重新充滿活力投入專題。

vigorous.en: The plants showed vigorous growth after moving closer to the window.
vigorous.zh: 植物移到窗邊後呈現旺盛生長。

villa.en: The old villa now serves as a small local museum.
villa.zh: 那棟老別墅現在作為地方小型博物館使用。

villain.en: The villain in the story is revealed near the final chapter.
villain.zh: 故事中的反派在最後幾章附近揭曉。

vine.en: A green vine climbed slowly along the garden wall.
vine.zh: 一株綠色藤蔓沿著花園牆面慢慢攀爬。

vinegar.en: The science activity compared vinegar with several other common liquids.
vinegar.zh: 科學活動比較醋與其他幾種常見液體。

vineyard.en: The documentary follows seasonal work at a hillside vineyard.
vineyard.zh: 紀錄片記錄山坡葡萄園的季節性工作。

violate.en: Copying another person's work can violate the school's academic rules.
violate.zh: 抄襲他人作品可能違反學校的學術規範。

violation.en: The referee explained the rule violation before restarting the game.
violation.zh: 裁判在比賽重新開始前說明了違規情況。

violet.en: A small violet flower grew beside the garden path.
violet.zh: 花園小徑旁長著一朵小紫羅蘭。

violin.en: She practiced the violin every afternoon before the school concert.
violin.zh: 學校音樂會前，她每天下午練習小提琴。

violinist.en: The violinist performed a short piece for the music class.
violinist.zh: 那位小提琴家為音樂課演奏了一首短曲。

virtual.en: The museum created a virtual tour for students studying from home.
virtual.zh: 博物館為在家學習的學生製作了虛擬導覽。

virtue.en: Patience is a virtue that can help during difficult group projects.
virtue.zh: 耐心是一種在困難小組專題中很有幫助的美德。

witness.en: A witness described what happened during the minor traffic accident.
witness.zh: 一名目擊者描述了那起輕微交通事故的經過。

witty.en: Her witty comment made the whole class laugh during the discussion.
witty.zh: 她機智的評論讓全班在討論時笑了出來。

wizard.en: The fantasy novel follows a young wizard learning ancient magic.
wizard.zh: 這本奇幻小說描述一位年輕巫師學習古老魔法。

woe.en: The poem uses the word woe to express deep sadness.
woe.zh: 這首詩用 woe 這個字表達深沉悲傷。

wolf.en: The documentary shows a wolf traveling across a snowy forest.
wolf.zh: 紀錄片拍到一隻狼穿越雪地森林。

wooden.en: A wooden bridge crosses the narrow stream behind the school.
wooden.zh: 學校後方有一座木橋跨過狹窄溪流。

woodpecker.en: A woodpecker tapped repeatedly on the tree outside our classroom.
woodpecker.zh: 一隻啄木鳥反覆啄著教室外的樹。

wool.en: The exhibit explains how wool is turned into fabric.
wool.zh: 展覽說明羊毛如何製成布料。

workbook.en: Please complete page twenty in the grammar workbook tonight.
workbook.zh: 今晚請完成文法練習簿第二十頁。

workforce.en: The report examines changes in the local workforce over ten years.
workforce.zh: 報告分析當地勞動人口十年來的變化。

workplace.en: Clear communication helps prevent confusion in any workplace.
workplace.zh: 清楚溝通有助於避免任何工作場所中的混亂。
